_about: Source term list for per-language glossaries (<lang>.json). Each language glossary maps every term to {"translation": "…", "keepEnglish": bool, "note": "…"}. Translators and reviewers must use the glossary rendering consistently.
doNotTranslate: passkey (keep the platform term used in the language if one exists)

terms.hashlist: An uploaded set of password hashes to crack (product concept)
terms.hash type: The hashcat hash mode, e.g. NTLM (mode 1000)
terms.crack: Verb: recover the plaintext of a hash
terms.cracked: Adjective: a hash whose plaintext was recovered
terms.potfile: hashcat's file of cracked hash:plaintext pairs
terms.wordlist: A dictionary file of candidate passwords
terms.mask: A hashcat mask pattern such as ?u?l?l?d
terms.charset: A custom character set for masks
terms.attack mode: hashcat attack mode (straight, combination, brute-force, hybrid)
terms.keyspace: Total number of candidates in an attack
terms.chunk: A slice of a job's keyspace given to one agent
terms.task: One chunk assignment running on an agent
terms.job: A cracking job against a hashlist
terms.workflow: An ordered sequence of preset jobs
terms.loopback: Re-running an attack using newly cracked passwords until nothing new is found
terms.max agents: Maximum agents a job may use
terms.overflow: Extra agents given to a job beyond its limit
terms.benchmark: hashcat speed test of an agent for a hash type
terms.progress: How much of the keyspace is done
terms.agent: A machine running the KrakenHashes agent and hashcat
terms.claim code: One-time or reusable code used to register an agent
terms.offline buffer: Grace period before an agent is reported offline
terms.binary: A hashcat binary version managed by the server
terms.client: A customer/engagement the hashlists belong to
terms.team: A group of users that share clients, hashlists and agents
terms.owner: The user an agent or resource belongs to
terms.retention: How long data is kept before deletion
terms.archive: Hide from default lists without deleting
terms.password reuse: Same password used by several accounts
terms.hash reuse: Same hash appearing for several accounts
terms.autosave: Saved automatically when leaving a field
terms.apply: Button: put pending changes into effect
terms.SAN: Subject Alternative Name on a certificate
terms.network share: SMB/NFS share used for wordlist storage
terms.mount: Attach a network share to a path
terms.threshold: Percentage of budget that triggers an action
terms.drain: Let running work finish without starting new work
terms.API key: Personal key for the HTTP API
terms.branding: Custom app name, colours and logo
